s: Dine mila beshabbat ubo y"d seipim: mila bizmannah docha et hashshabbat, shenneemar "ubayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato", bayyom vaapillu beshabbat, vehapperia hi mikkelal hammila, vehammetzitza gam ken docha et hashshabbat mippene hassakkana. Veken notenim aleha retiyya vekayyotze bah ap al pi sheaseru lecholeh sheen bo sakkana, veken lishar tzorke repuot milato dino kecholeh sheyyesh bo sakkana. Ella shellekattechilla tzarik lehakin meereb shabbat. Veim lo hekin meereb shabbat — muttar laasot beshabbat al yede shinnuy, kegon bimehem shehayu notenim al hammila kammon shachuq veyayin veshemen meorabim, im lo shachaq meereb shabbat — loes beshinnayv venoten. Veim lo ereb yayin veshemen meereb shabbat — lo yeorbem beshabbat, ella noten zeh bipne atzmo vezeh bipne atzmo, kede leshannot (uleinyan yom tob, nitbaer beyoreh dea simman rs"v). Veken lishar cholim, ap al pi shello haya yadua meereb shabbat sheyyitztareku leareb lahem yayin veshemen, mikkol maqom im en bahem sakkana — asur leareb lahem beshabbat (sheasur laasot lahem repua belo shinnuy, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"ch). Veim en lo kammon kelal, o shei epshar lelooso vetzarik leshochoqo, o lishchoq sammanim acherim hamatztzerim haddam — tiddacheh hammila ad lemachar, sheen docha shabbat ella mila atzmah abal lo makshireha, kemo sheyyitbaer, ella mippene hassakkana, veim ken en lahabio lekattechilla lide sakkana kede shennitztarek lechallel shabbat achar kak. Abal im haya lo kammon shachuq o sammanim shechuqim mibbeod yom umalu et haqqatan veachar kak nitpazzeru — shochaqan beshabbat, mippene hassakkana:
Kol zeman shello silleq yado mehammila — chozer apillu al tzitzin sheenan meakkebin bediabad. Silleq yado — eno chozer ella al tzitzin hamakkebin, shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman rs"d:
Ben ch' sheggameru searo vetzippornayv, o ben z' vadday ap al pi shello gameru — malin oto beshabbat. Sapeq ben z' sapeq ben ch' velo gameru — en lemulo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"l:

Mila shello bizmannah, apillu lo haya epshar lemulo qodem laken, kegon shehaya choleh, enah docha et hashshabbat, sheepshar lemulo achar hashshabbat, velo yihyeh shum chissur mitzva bezeh, shehare belo zeh enah bizmannah:

Mi shennolad beereb shabbat ben hashshemashot — en malin oto beshabbat, shehu sapeq shemini sapeq teshii, sheen dochin shabbat missapeq. Vaapillu lo hotzi ella rob rosho ben hashshemashot, ap al pi sheyyatza kullo beshabbat — hare zeh kenolad ben hashshemashot. Vehatchalat ben hashshemashot hu achar hilluk g' milin urebia leachar hatchalat hashsheqia, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a, vehu leerek rebiit shaa qodem tzet hakkokabim. Veim nolad qodem laken, ap al pi shekkebar shoqa hachamma — nimmol beyom v'. Veim nolad ken beshabbat — nimmol beshabbat. Veap sheyyesh omerim shemmittechillat hashsheqia hi layla kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom hare bimdinot ellu en anu chosheshin kelal ledibrehem, shellipamim en meqabbelim shabbat veosim kol hammelakot ad rebiit shaa qodem tzet hakkokabim, im ken en lanu lidchot hammila mizzemannah bishbil chashash zeh:

Anderoginos shehu sapeq zakar sapeq neqeba — en milato docha shabbat. Veken nolad keshehu mahul, apillu eno nireh mahul ella beet haqqishshuy, ap al pi shetztzarik lehattip mimmennu dam berit — eno docheh shabbat, mippene sheen zeh chiyyub barur min hattora. Veken yotze dopen, venokrit sheyyolda veachar kak nitgayyera, hoil veen immo temea leda — yesh lehistappeq im nimmolim bashshemini o miyyad shennoledu, shehare hattora somka milat shemini letumat hayyoledet. Veken mi sheyyesh lo shette orlot, dehaynu b' orot zeh al gabbe zeh, o shene gidim — yesh lehistappeq im nimmol bashshemini, shehare hattora omra "orlato" achat, lepikak nimmolim hem bashshemini missapeq, abal enan dochin et hashshabbat missapeq:

En docha et hashshabbat ella mila atzmah, shei epshar laasotah meereb shabbat. Abal kol makshire mila, kegon tiqqun haizmel vahabaato etzel hattinoq, ushechiqat sammanim, vetiqqun hechaluq sheyyitbaer, kevan sheepshar laasotam meereb shabbat — enan dochim et hashshabbat, apillu im neenas velo asaam, o sheasaam veneebdu. Vaapillu issur dibre soperim lo hittiru letzorek mitzvat mila, apillu im tiddacheh hammila legamre bishbil kak, kegon lehabi izmel mechatzer sheenah meorebet, o lissa hattinoq derek sham, sheheemidu chakamim et dibrehem apillu bimqom karet. Velomar lenokri laasot, im hu dabar sheim asahu yisrael en bo issur ella middibre soperim — omer lenokri veosehu, shello gazeru al shebut dishbut bimqom mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z. Veim hu dabar sheasur leyisrael laasoto min hattora, kegon letaqqen haizmel, o lahabio derek reshut harabbim gemura — lo yomar lenokri laasoto. Veyesh mattirim amira lenokri bimqom mitzva apillu bedabar haasur min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v. Veap sheen lismok al dibrehem bishar mitzva kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom bemila shehi atzmah docha shabbat — yesh lismok al dibrehem ap leinyan makshireha, im i epshar lamul hayyom beinyan acher:

Yesh oserin lehotzi hattinoq mibbeto lebet hakkeneset derek karmelit o chatzer sheenah meorebet apillu al yede nokri, sheen behotzaa zo tzorek mitzva, shehare epshar lemulo bebeto. Veyesh mattirin bezeh, mishshum "berab am hadrat melek". Veyesh lehanhig ken bimqomot shennohagim lehabi hattinoq lebet hakkeneset al yede sheechad noteno lachabero vachabero lachabero bepachot mid' ammot, sheyyotziuhu mereshut hayyachid al yede nokri veyaknisuhu al yede nokri, o yaasu kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"z. Abal lo yotziuhu veyaknisuhu al yede shenayim shezzeh oqer vezeh manniach, ap al pi shehu patur, mikkol maqom hare hu asur middibre soperim:

En osin lah chaluq, vehu sheyyiqqob chatika shel beged kede shettikkanes hammila beoto hanneqeb veyikrok shear habbeged al haeber vihaddeqennu sham, kede shello yachazor or haeber lekassot hammila. Abal korek aleha semartut. Veim lo hizmino mibbeod yom — mebi apillu mechatzer acheret shello erebu, ubilbad sheyyikrekennu al etzbao vibiennu, kede laasot beshinnuy. Veken muttar lahabio derek karmelit al yede shinnuy, abal lo derek reshut harabbim:

Izmel shel mila hu muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis, veasur letaltelo ella letzorek hammila velo kede lehatznio, vaapillu letzorek gupo umeqomo, vekol shekken shello letzorek kelal, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Umikkol maqom, beodo beyado keshemmal bo — rashshay letaltelo lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh lehatznio shamma, kemo shennitbaer sham. Abal asur lerochotzo apillu beodo beyado, sheen medichin kelim beshabbat ella letzorek hayyom, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"g:

Bime chakme hattalmud im lo hayu rochatzin havvalad lipne hammila uleachareha ubashshelishi lemila bemayim chammin — haya mesukkan. Veim hayu tzerikim lehachem beshabbat letzorek rechitza shellipne hammila — haya dino kedin tiqqun haizmel shennitbaer. Veim hayu tzerikim lehachem letzorek rechitza shelleachareha — haya dino kedin shechiqat sammanim shennitbaer. Veken shelishi lemila shechal beshabbat — mechammin lo chammin apillu al yede yisrael im lo hekinu meetmol, mippene shessakkana hi lo. Abal akshav lo nahagu birchitza kelal biqtzat medinot, vedino lirchotz beshabbat im ratzu kedin rechitzat kol adam, sheasur apillu bechamin shehuchammu mibbeod yom ella panayv yadayv veraglayv bilbad, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"v. Ubimdinot ellu nohagim lerochotzo lipne hammila bechammin shehuchammu meetmol, uleachar hammila bemotzae shabbat. Veken im haya yom g' beshabbat veroim sheyyesh tzorek lerochotzo — mekinim chammin mibbeod yom verochatzin oto beshabbat. Vekol zeh min hassetam, abal im roim sheyyesh lachush lesakkana im lo yirchatzu oto achar hammila — marchitzin oto, umechallelin alayv shabbat kemo al shear choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana:

Kesherochatzim oto lipne hammila — yizzaharu shello yishru sadin bemayim, sheshsheriyyat beged zehu kibbuso. Ella yasim nokri hassadin tok hammayim, shekkevan sheeno mitkavven lekibbus ella sheppesiq resheh hu — muttar al yede nokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Abal im nishpeku hachammin — lo yomar lenokri lehachem bishbilo:

Adam shello mal meolam — lo yamul beshabbat, shemma yeqalqel venimtza mechallel shabbat. Abal im mal kebar paam achat — muttar lamul beshabbat, vaapillu hu abi habben shealayv muttal lamul beno venoach lo mah shebbeno nittaqqen beshabbat al yede mila zo. Veken mi shemmal velo para meolam — asur liproa beshabbat:
Im malin ben hammumar o mumeret o haqqaraim beshabbat — nitbaer beyoreh dea simman rs"v. Vesham nitbaer im muttar sheyyihyeh echad mohel veechad porea:
